description: Source code for a web worker that manages loading and interacting with Pyodide (Python in WebAssembly). It handles importing modules, setting up the environment, executing Python code, and message handling for run, listen, and cancel events.

methods.name: setupPyodide
methods.description: Initializes Pyodide by loading it and setting up the environment, including writing helper files.

methods.name: resetPyodide
methods.description: Resets the Pyodide environment by nullifying the current instance and reinitializing.

methods.name: initRunPython
methods.description: Prepares the Python environment for code execution, including defining helper functions and exposing them to Python.

methods.name: handleRunRequest
methods.description: Handles execution of Python code received via message, manages exceptions, and communicates status back to the main thread.
